payload.content: Auth middleware is done. TASK-0003 can start — all protected routes now validate JWT. Let me know if you need the token helper function for tests.
Rate limiter (TASK-0004) is blocked: need to decide on storage backend — Redis or in-memory? In-memory won't survive pod restarts in prod. Flagging for decision.
Decision: use in-memory rate limiter for MVP, Redis for v2 when we add horizontal scaling. Single instance is fine for launch.
